label: November 1916
headline: A Kingdom of Poland
deck: Berlin and Vienna proclaim a Polish state; Mackensen crosses the Danube
caption: German pontoons carry troops across the Danube at Sistova in the mist
body: On 5 November Germany and Austria-Hungary proclaim a Kingdom of Poland in the lands taken from Russia. It has no king and no fixed borders, and Berlin hopes for Polish volunteers for its armies; few come forward.

In Romania the German Ninth Army under Falkenhayn breaks through the passes of the Jiu valley in snow and reaches the Wallachian plain. On 23 November Mackensen's army crosses the Danube from Bulgaria at Sistova, and the two forces close on Bucharest. The Romanian army prepares to make a stand on the river Argeș.
The hospital ship Britannic, sister of the Titanic, strikes a mine in the Aegean on 21 November and sinks in under an hour; of more than a thousand aboard, thirty die.
briefs: An aeroplane bombs London by day for the first time
Venizelos's government at Salonika declares war on Germany
Germany plans to require war work of all men aged 17 to 60
